name: Punjabi
description: Rich, hearty North Indian classics cooked with authentic spices. From creamy dals to tandoori specialties, our Punjabi menu is a celebration of bold flavours.

items.name: Dal Makhani
items.description: Slow-cooked whole black lentils and kidney beans simmered overnight in a rich tomato-butter-cream gravy.

items.name: Butter Chicken
items.description: Tender chicken marinated in yoghurt and spices, grilled in tandoor, then simmered in a velvety tomato-cream sauce.

items.name: Paneer Tikka
items.description: Cubes of fresh cottage cheese marinated in spiced yoghurt, skewered and grilled to perfection in a clay oven.

items.name: Assorted Naan Basket
items.description: A basket of freshly baked naan — plain, butter, garlic, or stuffed — straight from the tandoor.

items.name: Sweet Lassi
items.description: Thick, chilled yoghurt drink blended with sugar and cardamom — the perfect accompaniment to a Punjabi feast.

name: Gujarati
description: Gujarat's celebrated thali tradition brought to life — a harmonious balance of sweet, tangy, and spicy flavours across seasonal vegetables and wholesome dals.

items.name: Gujarati Thali
items.description: A complete meal — dal, sabzi, roti, rice, kadhi, papad, pickle, and a sweet — all in one satisfying thali.

items.name: Steamed Dhokla
items.description: Soft, spongy fermented chickpea cake tempered with mustard seeds and green chilli. A Gujarati breakfast staple.

items.name: Undhiyu
items.description: A seasonal winter delicacy of mixed vegetables and fenugreek dumplings slow-cooked with spiced coconut masala.

items.name: Gujarati Kadhi
items.description: A light, slightly sweet yoghurt-based curry with curry leaves and mustard tempering — comforting and unique.

name: South Indian
description: Crispy dosas, fluffy idlis, and aromatic sambhar — our South Indian section brings the authentic tastes of the South to Navsari.

items.name: Masala Dosa
items.description: A golden, paper-thin rice crepe filled with spiced potato masala. Served with coconut chutney and sambar.

items.name: Idli Sambar (4 pcs)
items.description: Soft, steamed rice and lentil cakes served with a bowl of lentil vegetable stew and three chutneys.

items.name: Medu Vada (2 pcs)
items.description: Crunchy deep-fried lentil doughnuts with a soft interior. Best enjoyed dunked in sambar.

items.name: Onion Uttapam
items.description: A thick, savoury rice pancake topped with finely chopped onions, tomatoes, and green chillies.

name: Chinese (Desi)
description: Indian-Chinese fusion classics — the comfort food that never fails to delight. Saucy, bold, and utterly satisfying.

items.name: Veg Fried Rice
items.description: Wok-tossed long-grain rice with seasonal vegetables, soy sauce, and a hint of sesame oil.

items.name: Gobi Manchurian (Dry)
items.description: Crispy cauliflower fritters tossed in a tangy garlic-ginger-soy sauce. A crowd favourite.

items.name: Veg Hakka Noodles
items.description: Thin egg-free noodles stir-fried with fresh vegetables and classic Indo-Chinese seasonings.

name: Snacks & Beverages
description: Light bites and refreshing drinks for any time of day — from a quick chai to an evening snack spread.

items.name: Masala Chai
items.description: Freshly brewed spiced tea with ginger, cardamom, and cinnamon — the perfect morning companion.

items.name: Grilled Veg Sandwich
items.description: A buttery grilled sandwich loaded with seasonal vegetables and green chutney. Served with tomato ketchup.

items.name: Samosa (2 pcs)
items.description: Crispy pastry shells filled with spiced potato and peas. Served hot with tamarind chutney.

items.name: Fresh Lime Soda
items.description: A refreshing blend of fresh lime juice, soda water, and your choice of sweet, salt, or masala.
